title: Enforce A2A capability scope predicates
summary: Enforce stable A2A scope predicates so signed A2A grants constrain peer pubkeys, task ids, lease ids, and duplicate-risk posture at dispatch.
expectedFailureModes: A scoped a2a.send grant can dispatch to a different recipient than the signed peer_pubkey_b58.
A scoped a2a.respond grant can post a result for a task outside the signed task_id.
An A2A repair grant can requeue or force-error the wrong lease or duplicate-risk mode.
nextAction: Add shared A2A scope evaluators, gate send/recv/respond/repair paths, audit scope rejections, and update capability docs.
